Fresh Blackberry Lemonade
By: BreeAnna Laub
Published: Friday, March 28, 2014 - 12:23pm

Ingredients




2 c water
3 lemons
1 lime
1 c blackberries
half of a tomato
2/3 c sugar
Ice

Preparation

1 Put all ingredients in to blender in order listed making sure they are cut up to appropriate size for your blender. 2 Blend well and enjoy!

About

This is a lemonade recipe that has a blackberry twist. There isn't much you can do to make lemonade healthy because of all the sugar required but I do always try to add a little something extra in my smoothies and the tomato in this one gives the smoothie a lovely pink/purple color when mixed with the blackberries.
